content: Hi! How can I assist you with your account or payments today? If you're checking on tuition or shared expenses, I can compare our supported platforms and track receipts for you.
I made my tuition payment to the school yesterday, but I want to be sure it posted. I used PayPal and included my student ID 1178239.

Glad you mentioned that! I see a PayPal transaction of $2,450 from your account (ending in @ramirez.edu) posted on June 3rd, at 4:18 PM. The note lists your student ID 1178239. Your payment cleared successfully.
Perfect, I was worried because PayPal gave me a reference code, PP-6881RZT. The school needs it by the deadline today.
Absolutely, the reference code PP-6881RZT is recorded alongside your payment. Since today is the cutoff, I've attached it to your student profile under Diego Ramirez to avoid any late fees.
Thanks! Out of curiosity, is there a benefit to paying my next semester with a bank transfer instead of PayPal?

Great question! Bank transfers (using your IBAN, like ES91 2100 0418 4502 0005 1332) usually clear in 1-2 business days and don't incur PayPal's 2.9% fee. However, PayPal is faster for urgent deadlines and offers instant confirmation, like you experienced today.
Good to know. I'll weigh that for next term. Can I get a confirmation email at diego.ramirez@uni.edu?

Of course! A receipt for your $2,450 PayPal payment, including reference PP-6881RZT and your student ID 1178239, will be sent to diego.ramirez@uni.edu within the next hour. Let me know if you need it expedited.
